author: Qwen team, official QwenLM GitHub repository README
text: We release Qwen3.5. The first release includes a 397B-A17B MoE model. ... More sizes are coming & Happy Chinese New Year!
notes: Fulfilled by the medium series (2026-02-24) and the small series (2026-03-02, alibaba-qwen3-5-small).

author: Qwen team, Qwen3.6-Plus launch post (official Alibaba Cloud Community mirror)
text: In the coming days, we will also open-source smaller-scale variants
notes: Fulfilled 2026-04-16 (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B) and 2026-04-22 (Qwen3.6-27B, alibaba-qwen3-6-27b). Date is the mirror date; original qwen.ai post not retrievable.

author: Qwen team, Qwen3.6-Max-Preview launch post (official Alibaba Cloud Community mirror)
text: we are continuing to iterate and expect further gains in subsequent versions
notes: Generic roadmap statement about the next Max model; the next Max release was Qwen3.7-Max (2026-05-20). Mirror date; China release notes date the preview 2026-04-20.

author: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio release notes (official)
text: The Max model, the largest and most capable variant in the Qwen3.7 series, is available as a preview and supports only thinking mode
notes: Public pay-as-you-go preview listed one day before qwen3.7-max (2026-05-21).

author: Qwen team, "Qwen3.7: The Agent Frontier" (official Alibaba Cloud Community mirror)
text: Qwen3.7-Max will be available soon through Alibaba Cloud Model Studio.
notes: Stated at announcement; qwen3.7-max appears in International release notes 2026-05-21. Mirror date; original post likely 2026-05-20.

author: Alibaba Cloud documentation (Qoder CN / Lingma), "Qwen3.8-Max-Preview Limited-Time Offer"
notes: Offer for Qoder CN users to use Qwen3.8-Max-Preview; ended 2026-08-03 10:00 (Beijing). posted_at is the stated start date; the page publication date itself is not shown. Qwen3.8-Max reached the public API 2026-08-02.

author: Qwen team, Qwen3.8-Max launch post (official Alibaba Cloud Community mirror)
text: The model weights will be open-sourced on Hugging Face and ModelScope next week.
notes: Relative date ("next week"); weights published 2026-08-12 per GitHub README. Mirror date; original post may be 2026-08-02.

author: Qwen team, Qwen3.8-27B Hugging Face model card
text: Qwen3.8-27B will be available as a hosted version with more production features ... The service is coming soon.
notes: API qwen3.8-27b listed 2026-08-17. posted_at = open-weight release date per GitHub README (card text may have been edited since).

author: Qwen team, official QwenLM/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next GitHub README
text: a multimodal MoE model that also serves as an early preview of the architecture used in Qwen4
notes: First official naming of Qwen4 found; no date given. Qwen4-Max released 2026-11-16.

author: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio documentation and release notes (official)
text: The preview period runs from 10:00 on November 11, 2026 to 24:00 on November 25, 2026 (UTC+8)
notes: Token Plan subscribers only ("Pay-as-you-go access is not supported"); release notes entry dated 2026-11-11 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/newly-released-models). Production Qwen4-Max followed 2026-11-16.

author: Alibaba Group press release (Alibaba Cloud press room)
text: Open-weight, smaller-scale models from the Qwen4 series will soon be released to developers worldwide.
notes: Not shipped as of 2026-11-20; no release row.

author: Qwen team, Qwen3-TTS Hugging Face model card
text: Other models mentioned in the technical report will be released in the near future.
notes: No follow-up open-weight Qwen3-TTS model found on the Qwen HF org through 2026-11-20. posted_at = release date of the card per GitHub README.
